title: Mosaic art
text:
It was a lot of fun.
It was my first experience of mosaic art, but they explained how to do it and how to design it carefully, and it was a fun memory that was typical of Spain.
I highly recommend it.
author: Jet66228592452

title: Awesome family activity
text:
The Mosqic activity was memorable. I went with my wife and two kids (11 and 16). All of us thoroughly enjoyed the activity. It lasted two hours and went by very quickly. 

We spend 10 days in Barcelona and this was the best activity we did during our stay.
author: Eban_B

title: Definitely worth the time!
text: Was a great way to spend time as a fmaily making unique and memorable souvenirs - we booked 2 hours and it was just enough for our girls - they tailor what you make based on how much time you have - by far our favorite souvenirs from our Spain trip came from this!
author: WheretoNext999

title: MUST DO Activity when in Barcelona
text: Very friendly and helpful staff.  They are very patient with the children and adults as well.  We had an amazing time making our masterpieces!!!!  A MUST DO if visiting Barcelona.
author: misahana808

title: Really fun!
text: We had such a fun time doing this and our mosaics actually came out really well! My husband and I are not artistic at all, and even he had a great time. Kids are 11 and 14 and both had a blast and were very happy with their pieces.
author: Kira_A

title: Excellent experience
text: Thank you for a lovely experience. We chose the 2 hour course and were a group of 2 adults and 2 8 year olds. The activities were personalised and we were able to enjoy an experience personalised to age. We learnt lots about how to cut and place the tiles effectively. The course leaders were friendly and helpful and we were able to collect our finished items the same day. Highly recommended.
author: hmw186399

title: Wonderful experience. Highly recommend!
text: We had a wonderful time making mosaics on our last day in Barcelona. So great for the whole family - the kids loved it and we have wonderful souvenirs. Definitely a highlight of our trip and we are so glad we did this. It was so relaxing and the finished results are beautiful. Such a great way bring Gaudi to life!
author: Z381ZYlynnw

title: Incredible Immersive Barcelona Experience!
text: We took our six-year-old daughter to Mosaiccos on a recent vacation to Barcelona and we all created our own mosaic. It was an incredible experience for all of us and we highly recommend it to any family or individual travelling to Barcelona!! It was such a fun, immersive experience that allowed us to learn, create, and have fun. The mosaics we made will be treasured keepsakes for many years to come. Thank you Mosaiccos for the incredible experience!! We will be back.
author: 436katey

title: Perfect Gaudi Experience
text: What a fun way to gain an appreciation for Gaudi’s brilliance! Our family visited Casa Battlo and then relaxed together, creating our own mosaics at Mosaiccos. It was an absolutely wonderful day and the time at Mosaiccos flew. The staff was so kind and helpful, and we had a terrific time breaking tiles and arranging and gluing them onto a tray - which Mosaiccos grouted and had ready for us in 2 days! There’s so much to see and do in Barcelona and this was the perfect place to catch our breath. It’s right near the museums and wonderful food too. We highly recommend!!!
author: Curious401799

title: Great family experience!
text: We had a great experience here as part of a tour with Sagrada Familia.  Our family of four (children 10/12 yo) had fun!  We all felt successful creating our choice of projects (picture frame, animal print, treasure box).  There were quite a few student interns available to help us.  The two hour time limit went quickly and we could have actually spent more time.  Highly recommend.  One of our families top activities this trip and we have great souvenirs too!
author: AmyR812
